title: Lifting a derived stalk morphism to a local chain map
statement: For a scheme and a point, a derived morphism between the stalk complexes of two global complexes, each represented by strictly perfect models on an affine neighbourhood, is represented after a smaller affine restriction by a chain map between those models, with canonical derived stalk comparisons carrying that chain map to the given morphism. The models and the neighbourhood are part of the conclusion [def-pc-scheme] [def-pc-derived-category] [def-pc-module-stalk-functor] [def-pc-perfect-complex].

proof.text: Use the source definition perfectLocalModelStalkComparison to construct the canonical isomorphisms a:Q(S_U P) to Q(G_x) and b:Q(S_U Q) to Q(H_x) from iG and iH. Its complete construction applies the exact open stalk functor, its derived factorization, the restriction-stalk-extension comparison, and the invertible stalk-ring restriction/extension adjunction.

Transport t to a.hom followed by t followed by b.inv. Apply the existing source open-stalk derived Hom descent theorem to get V and g in the derived category on V, with its equality in canonical comparison coordinates. Define c to be Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso of openModuleStalkRestrictionComparison, and take cP = DerivedCategory.Q.mapIso (c.app P) and cQ = DerivedCategory.Q.mapIso (c.app Q). These are precisely the canonical comparisons in the descent equation. The original public hypotheses and conclusion of this consumer remain unchanged.

Apply the proved general functor lemma map_strictlyPerfect_of_mapFree: any zero-morphism-preserving functor with finite-free comparison isomorphisms preserves boundedness and transports the termwise finite-free retractions. Specialize it to restriction using mapFreeIso and overMapUnitIso. Apply perfect_affine_map_representative on V to obtain a chain map f with Q(f)=g.

Naturality of S.mapDerivedCategoryFactors gives Q(S(f)) as its inverse factor on the source followed by S.mapDerivedCategory(g) followed by its factor on the target. Substitute the descent equation. The source theorem uses the canonical cG=cP followed by a and cH=cQ followed by b, so associativity proves its equality. These canonical comparisons witness the existential comparisons of the original node assertion. The source theorem does not need hU; it therefore implies that assertion on every affine U. The existing source parent already calls this stronger theorem and the dependency node remains in place.

theorem exists_affine_perfect_stalk_hom_lift
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ W : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over W))]
    (x : X) [HasDerivedCategory.{v} (ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.stalk x))]
    (G H : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (U : X.Opens) (hxU : x ∈ U)
    (P Q : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hP : IsStrictlyPerfect X U P) (hQ : IsStrictlyPerfect X U Q)
    (iG : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj G) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)
    (iH : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj H) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)
    (t : DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj G) ⟶
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj H)) :
    ∃ (V : X.Opens) (hxV : x ∈ V) (_hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hVU : V ≤ U),
      let T := (SheafOfModules.overMap.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE hVU : V ⟶ U)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
      let S : SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V) ⥤
          ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.stalk x) := openModuleStalkFunctor X V ⟨x, hxV⟩
      letI : S.PreservesZeroMorphisms :=
        AlgebraicGeometry.openModuleStalkFunctor_preservesZeroMorphisms X V ⟨x, hxV⟩
      let c : T ⋙ S.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅
          (openModuleStalkFunctor X U ⟨x, hxU⟩).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) :=
        Functor.mapHomologicalComplexCompIso
          (openModuleStalkRestrictionComparison X U V hVU x hxU hxV) (.up ℤ)
      let cG := DerivedCategory.Q.mapIso (c.app P) ≪≫
        perfectLocalModelStalkComparison X x U hxU G P iG
      let cH := DerivedCategory.Q.mapIso (c.app Q) ≪≫
        perfectLocalModelStalkComparison X x U hxU H Q iH
      ∃ f : T.obj P ⟶ T.obj Q,
        DerivedCategory.Q.map
          ((S.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map f) =
            cG.hom ≫ t ≫ cH.inv
